children: Eurozone government bond yields rise slightly after dropping the previous session as investors await fresh impulse from U.S. employment data at 1230 GMT. Friday's eurozone economic data calendar is empty, and there is no government bond issuance either, other than Belgium's optional reverse inquiry auction. The focus, however, will gradually turn to the European Central Bank's meeting on Sept. 10, where a 25-basis-point rate hike is fully priced, according to LSEG. The 10-year German Bund yield rises 1.0 basis points to 3.361%, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
